raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure contains two separate line charts labeled A and B. Chart A plots "Средни пеплодни (дни)" (Average daylight hours (days)) on the vertical axis against "Години" (Years) on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis ranges from 200 to 280 with labeled tick marks at 200, 220, 240, 260, and 280. The horizontal axis spans from 2008 to 2021, with labeled tick marks at 2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021. A single red line connects data points at the following coordinates: (2008, 280), (2012/2013, 270), (2017, 240), and (2021, 200). Chart B plots "Структурен ефект върху средни пеплодни (%)" (Structural effect on average daylight hours (%)) on the vertical axis against "Години" (Years) on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 2.0 with labeled tick marks at 0.0, 1.0, and 2.0. The horizontal axis spans from 2008 to 2021, with labeled tick marks at 2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021. A single red line connects data points at the following coordinates: (2008, 1.5), (2012/2013, 0.8), (2017, 1.2), and (2021, 2.0). Both charts use red lines with circular markers at each data point.
